regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is heavily concentrated in Energy (H-shares), with Banks (H + HK) a crowded second and High-Dividend Blue Chips third; only four themes are trend-gate eligible, giving a narrow breadth-of-rotation. The absolute-trend gate has historically helped on this market (gate_helps true), but cross-sectional momentum is a focus lens only — no predictive edge — and most themes are unscorable, so I keep conviction low and structure leans as conditionals.
emerging_watch: Watch whether High-Dividend Blue Chips (eligible, durability_bar 0.73, breadth 0.75, not crowded) closes the gap on Banks for the #2 slot — a confirmed overtake in rank with Banks simultaneously losing gate eligibility would mark a real rotation toward income/defensive within the HK leaderboard; if Dividends fall back below rank 3 or lose gate eligibility first, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only theme combining the validated absolute-trend gate eligibility with the strongest trend-health leg: durability_bar 0.76, hurst 'trend', breadth 0.8, and it is not crowded (crowding_z 0.38). The gate is the one validated edge on this market and it is currently letting Energy through, so a vol-aware trend-following lean is directionally consistent with discipline — but the unscorable proxy means this is an expression of trend-health, not a return forecast.
evidence: eligible: true with durability_bar 0.76 (highest) and hurst_tag 'trend'
crowded: false (crowding_z 0.38) so no size-down caution triggered
gate_helps true — the absolute-trend gate cuts drawdown on this market's history
theses.dissent: Energy is reflexively still the leader after a long run, and cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0, so the rank itself carries no forward return signal; the only real support is the risk-control gate, not alpha.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) falls below its absolute-trend threshold and loses gate eligibility before the check-by date

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks pass the absolute-trend gate (eligible true, durability_bar 0.63) and sit second in momentum, which suggests a co-leadership structure rather than a one-narrative regime (one_narrative false). The crowding flag (crowded true, crowding_z 1.09) is a size-down caution only — it does not justify fading — and the mean-revert hurst tag tempers any strong expectation of continuation.
evidence: eligible: true with durability_bar 0.63, passing the gate
rank 2 with score 1.382 (second-highest) and rotation challenger role
one_narrative false — leadership is shared, not singular
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded and mean-reverting, so the very concentration that keeps it on the leaderboard is the same reflexivity that can snap back; momentum rank has no forward edge.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) lose gate eligibility AND fall below half their current durability_bar before the check-by date

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is the only tech name with an ETF proxy (3033.HK, scorable), but it fails the absolute-trend gate (eligible false, durability_bar 0.23), has weak breadth (0.158), and sits deep in the bottom half of ranks. On a market where the gate has historically helped, staying out of a gate-ineligible theme is the one disciplined directional call this detector supports — and it happens to be the only scorable subject.
evidence: eligible: false with durability_bar 0.23 — fails the absolute-trend gate
etf_proxy '3033.HK' and scorable: true — the one theme that can be graded
hurst_tag 'mean-revert' and breadth 0.158 — weak, non-cohesive trend health
theses.dissent: Mean-reversion can work in both directions, and a snap-back in tech is possible given its deep unwind; avoiding a beaten-down leader risks missing a reversal even if the gate is right more often than not.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK regains gate eligibility (durability_bar rises above the absolute-trend threshold) before the check-by date
